BiblicalUsage: Halah is a region of Assyria, and its name marks the exile. When Samaria fell, Israel was carried away and placed in Halah and in Habor by the river of Gozan, and the tribes beyond the Jordan were carried there too.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Halah is where the ten tribes went, and the map still remembers what the nation forgot.
